name: bdk
description: Sift AI claims, ideas, and products through the seven-step Baloney Funnel (outcome, receipts, labels, sell-by, relevance, taste test, pivot-punt-pursue) down to what has earned the next investment.

interface.shortDescription: Sift AI claims down to what has earned investment.
interface.longDescription: Run AI claims, roadmaps, and vendor pitches through the seven-step Baloney Funnel: Chaos (outcome, receipts), Confusion (labels, sell-by, relevance), Crapola (taste test), and Considered (valuable, usable, viable, feasible), ending in pivot, punt, or pursue, with the why. Guided Discovery, Context Dump, and Spitballing modes; five voices.
defaultPrompt: Run this AI roadmap through the Baloney Funnel.
Check the receipts on this vendor claim.
Is this AI pitch value or theater?
